Provided you're not allergic, I urge everyone who hates clam chowder (or cream of celery, cream of brocolli, etc.) to give it another shot. Try using it as a substitute for milk when making Kraft/mac & cheese or mashed potatoes. If you don't have mac & cheese, you can always mix in a can or two of assorted veggies. It can be a little salty, so you might have to play around with adding a bit of water-- but I found it to be absolutely delicious.

The fact that everyone hates it also seems to have made clam chowder a dirt-cheap buy. Case in point, my last clam chowder & mixed veggie meal (which was quite filling) came to about $1.90 and was ready after about 8 minutes in the microwave. Alright, so it's not gourmet, but it gets the job done. Next time, I'll probably throw in a half-can of beans for some protein.
